overall_notes: The paper focuses on data augmentation for Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction (ASTE) using target-to-source sentence generation. The NLG component is the sentence generator used for creating augmented training data. Automatic metrics (F1, Precision, Recall) are used to evaluate the downstream ASTE task performance. Human evaluation assesses the quality of generated sentences themselves.
